Ex7RD.justification: Use a browser baseline because attendees, member count and unavailable states deliberately differ from Pencil sample data. Header, navigation, summary and upcoming sections have independent order and touch-target probes. F40: the join-request count is read once, only for the selected community's admins (exact zero or N / N+ from one authorized page, linked to Requests); members and failed reads keep the unavailable line and trigger no read. Upcoming rows lead with a time column over a day column in the event time zone.

y4Zeg.justification: Use a browser baseline because only the caller’s skill row is sourced. Authorization, section order, self/provisional state and the mutually exclusive skill/league rows are separately probed. The budget allows small font rasterization differences, not alternate layouts.
